Untuned operations keep the generated request: their success reaches the handler on the standard fixture and their error is the catalog check's validation.invalid. The tuned ones reach a handler-level refusal (an unknown fixture object, a URL or app the handler refuses, Gate A2) or need a precondition the generated request lacks. Two successes need the app product: workspace.agent_folder.set is a user-only operation (request_origin.rs USER_ONLY_OPERATIONS; origin user is only the verified app connection, server/client_hello.rs), and workspace.ensure_app needs an installed app (the app bundle ships the first-party apps, installed by default; the VM daemon has none beside its binary).
